subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: After the workspace-path defect is fixed, should OpenClaw sponsor this grouped Claw schema and gated core CLI as the RFC 0016 foundation while the RFC still has unresolved review changes?
rationale: The patch establishes a new core packaging and lifecycle contract whose permanent schema, command names, ownership, and migration expectations cannot be approved through correctness review alone.

options.title: Wait for RFC approval
options.body: Keep this PR open and refresh it only after RFC 0016 settles the schema, CLI, ownership, and compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor experimental foundation
options.body: Approve the process-gated read-only slice now and explicitly own any later migration or removal required by RFC changes.

options.title: Move outside core
options.body: Require existing plugin or ClawHub surfaces unless the RFC demonstrates a missing generic core API.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC approval
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and refresh it only after RFC 0016 settles the schema, CLI, ownership, and compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the central agent-config, agent-creation, CLI, and cron boundaries, providing the strongest available cross-surface decision route.
